question: A 55-year-old woman with no symptoms, no family history, and heterogeneously dense breasts presents for her first breast cancer screen. Which imaging modality is most appropriate as the primary screening tool?

answers.text: Breast MRI — it gives the highest sensitivity regardless of breast density

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Breast MRI has high sensitivity but is not used as a population screening tool due to high cost, limited availability, and low specificity leading to many false positives. It is reserved for high-risk women (BRCA carriers, >20% lifetime risk).

answers.text: Mammography (2-view digital) — it remains the standard population screening modality for women 40–74 years

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Mammography is the standard population screening modality. For dense breasts, supplemental ultrasound may be added, and tomosynthesis (3D mammography) improves cancer detection. MRI is reserved for very high-risk women.

answers.text: Ultrasound alone — it is radiation-free and superior to mammography in dense breast tissue

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Ultrasound is not used as a standalone screening tool because it has low specificity (high false-positive rate) and is operator-dependent. It is used as a supplement to mammography in dense breasts or as the primary tool in women under 30.

answers.text: No imaging is needed — breast cancer screening should begin only after age 60

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Most guidelines recommend initiating mammographic screening at 40–50 years. A 55-year-old woman is clearly within the screening age range and should have regular mammography.

overallFeedback.feedback: Remember the screening vs diagnostic distinction: mammography screens asymptomatic women; ultrasound characterises a palpable lump or supplements mammography in dense breasts; MRI is for high-risk surveillance.
Correct. Mammography is the evidence-based population screening standard. In dense breasts, tomosynthesis or supplemental ultrasound may be added, but mammography remains the primary modality.
